marginal_coverage_closure.mathematical_implication: For every coordinate i, {all coordinates covered} is a subset of {coordinate i covered}. event_pit_contract.bar_interval_definition: B_0(t) is last completed bar finalized at UTC hour t; B_entry(t) is [t, t+1h)
event_pit_contract.source_finalization_timestamp: t_avail(B_k) = T_{k+1}, bar finalized and available at UTC hour boundary
event_pit_contract.decision_boundary: t = T_{k+1}, causal execution decision occurs at t, strictly <= t information cutoff, zero forward leakage
event_pit_contract.reference_entry_price: P_entry(t) = Open(B_entry(t)) causally following B_0(t) finalization
event_pit_contract.reference_exit_timestamp: t_exit = t + h, where h in {4, 8, 24}
event_pit_contract.horizon_return_formula: r_gross(t) = s_t * (P_exit(t) / P_entry(t) - 1) on equal entry notional
event_pit_contract.right_boundary_censoring: Events with t + h > T_partition_end strictly prospectively censored (A[i, t] = 0); requires h-hour reserve at partition end
event_pit_contract.synchronized_eligibility: Both BTC and ETH 1h bars must be finalized, non-missing, and consecutive at t
event_pit_contract.missing_bar_handling: Missing or non-consecutive hourly bars fail closed with A[i, t] = 0
event_pit_contract.train_frozen_q80_policy: Linear interpolation quantile computed exclusively on WF1_TRAIN valid bars (minimum N >= 500); permanently frozen before WF1_CALIBRATION

endpoint_contract.claim_scope: equal-entry-notional, event-conditioned directional expectancy after a fixed friction proxy, before funding and portfolio constraints.
claim_scope_exclusions: capital-normalized portfolio return or Sharpe ratio
funded perpetual return with funding/borrow carry
executable strategy with position sizing, inventory limits, slippage modeling, or order-book queue dynamics
endpoint_contract.stress_role: Diagnostic only; cannot overturn or substitute primary 12bp gate

inference_contract.methodology: shared-clock, source-bundle preserving, non-circular moving-block Studentized bootstrap-t single-step joint maximum inference
inference_contract.point_estimator: ratio estimator mu_hat_i = sum_t Z_{i,t} / sum_t A_{i,t}
inference_contract.joint_shared_clock_rule: Exactly one block-index sequence tau_1..tau_m drawn per bootstrap replicate and applied jointly across all K=20 candidates and both assets
inference_contract.ratio_estimator_lrv: Kuensch (1989) ratio-estimator moving block sum variance formula SE_hat_i = sqrt( (1 / (L*S)) * sum_s (Z^{(L)}_{i,s} - mu_hat_i * A^{(L)}_{i,s})^2 ) / A_bar_i
inference_contract.bootstrap_centering_rule: center_i = sum_j Z^{(L)}_{i, tau_j} / sum_j A^{(L)}_{i, tau_j} (non-circular moving block sum)
inference_contract.critical_value_c95: 95th percentile of empirical bootstrap distribution of joint maximum statistic
inference_contract.zero_event_fail_closed: Candidates failing support floors or with zero events receive LCB = -infinity
inference_contract.power_interpretation_guardrail: Failure to obtain simultaneous LCB > 0 on exploratory Discovery is not equivalent to proof of zero economic edge when the candidate's method-power class is limited. Low synthetic power must not be used to relax the LCB > 0 selection gate.

required_properties: Strict volume and trade count integrity
Synchronized joint timestamps between BTC and ETH across 2021-01-01 to 2023-04-30 UTC
16 source invariants from Controller Adjudication R1

validation_lifecycle_contract.candidate_selection_rule: Deterministic ranking among candidates with valid simultaneous LCB > 0: (1) highest full-precision LCB, (2) larger event count N, (3) lexicographically lower candidate ID
validation_lifecycle_contract.no_go_outcome: H41_EXPLORATORY_NO_GO if 0 candidates pass LCB > 0 gate
validation_lifecycle_contract.single_candidate_gate: Exactly one locked candidate enters WF1_VALIDATION
validation_lifecycle_contract.no_fallback_rule: If locked candidate fails validation, Candidate #2 is NOT evaluated; campaign terminates as validation failure
validation_lifecycle_contract.no_retuning_rule: Zero hyperparameter tuning or semantic modification permitted after unsealing
validation_lifecycle_contract.successor_campaign_requirement: Evaluating alternative candidates requires a separate authorized successor campaign
